detail.readme:
# Claude HUD A Claude Code plugin that shows what's happening: context usage, rate limits, active tools, running agents, and todo progress, always visible below your input. [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/jarrodwatts/claude-hud?v=2)](LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/jarrodwatts/claude-hud)](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud/stargazers) ![Claude HUD in action](claude-hud-preview-5-2.png) > 🌐 English | [中文文档](README.zh.md) ## Install Inside Claude Code, run: ``` /plugin marketplace add jarrodwatts/claude-hud /plugin install claude-hud /reload-plugins /hud ``` `/hud` checks your setup and points your status line at the HUD, after asking you. It needs Node.js 22.18 or later; if yours is older, `/hud` finds a newer one on your machine or helps you install one.
Prefer the terminal? ```bash claude plugin marketplace add jarrodwatts/claude-hud claude plugin install claude-hud@claude-hud ``` Then run `/reload-plugins` and `/hud` inside a session.
**Updates:** Claude Code doesn't auto-update third-party plugins by default. To turn it on, run `/plugin`, open **Marketplaces**, select **claude-hud**, and choose **Enable auto-update**. Or update by hand with `claude plugin marketplace update claude-hud` and `claude plugin update claude-hud@claude-hud`, then `/reload-plugins`. You don't need to set it up again. ## What You See The default is two lines: ``` [Opus] │ my-project git:(main*) Context █████░░░░░ 45% │ Usage ██░░░░░░░░ 25% (resets in 1h 30m) ``` - **Line 1**: model, a provider label when one is detected (`Bedrock`, `Vertex`, `MiniMax`), project path, and git branch. - **Line 2**: context used (green, then yellow, then red as it fills) and your subscriber rate limits. Optional lines include tools, agents and todos, plus about a hundred other options: ``` ◐ Edit: auth.ts | ✓ Read ×3 | ✓ Grep ×2 ← tools ◐ explore [haiku]: Finding auth code (2m 15s) ← agents ▸ Fix authentication bug (2/5) ← todos ``` ## Change It, Fix It, Report It Ask Claude, or type `/hud` and say what you want: "show tool activity", "use the compact layout", "the HUD is blank", "the context bar looks wrong". Claude looks up the options, shows you a preview, and saves the change once you approve it. `/hud` also undoes the last change, replays the last real render to explain what you see, and, for a real bug, writes a scrubbed report that you read in full before anything is filed. Settings live in `~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/config.json` (under `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` if set). To turn the HUD off for one session, start Claude Code with `CLAUDE_HUD_DISABLE=1`. ## Security The HUD's logic runs in a locked-down Node process. Node's permission model blocks it from starting programs, reading your credentials, and writing anywhere but its own data folder. An import fence keeps Node's network modules and globals out of its reach; that fence blocks every way out found so far, and is tested against each one on every change. A small separate file runs the fixed `git`, `jj` and memory commands it needs. The HUD reads Claude Code's stdin, the session transcript, Claude config files, and git or jj metadata for the current directory, and calls no undocumented APIs. `--extra-cmd` runs a shell command on every refresh and puts its output on the first line. It is ignored unless `CLAUDE_HUD_ALLOW_EXTRA_CMD=1` is set in the HUD's environment. Treat it as arbitrary code execution and never use a command from an untrusted source. ## Requirements - Claude Code v2.1.260 or later - Node.js 22.18 or later (Bun can start the HUD, which then runs on Node) ## Development ```bash git clone https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud cd claude-hud npm ci && npm test ``` See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=jarrodwatts/claude-hud&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#jarrodwatts/claude-hud&Date)

# Claude HUD 一个 Claude Code 插件，常驻在输入框下方，实时显示上下文用量、使用率限制、正在运行的工具、子代理以及待办进度。 [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/jarrodwatts/claude-hud?v=2)](LICENSE) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/jarrodwatts/claude-hud)](https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud/stargazers) ![Claude HUD 运行效果](claude-hud-preview-5-2.png) > 🌐 [English](README.md) | 中文文档 ## 安装 在 Claude Code 中运行： ``` /plugin marketplace add jarrodwatts/claude-hud /plugin install claude-hud /reload-plugins /hud ``` `/hud` 会检查你的环境，并在征得你同意后把状态栏指向 HUD。它需要 Node.js 22.18 或更高版本；如果你的版本较旧，`/hud` 会在你的机器上找到更新的版本，或帮你安装一个。
更喜欢用终端？ ```bash claude plugin marketplace add jarrodwatts/claude-hud claude plugin install claude-hud@claude-hud ``` 然后在会话中运行 `/reload-plugins` 和 `/hud`。
**更新：** 默认情况下，Claude Code 不会自动更新第三方插件。要开启自动更新，运行 `/plugin`，打开 **Marketplaces**，选择 **claude-hud**，然后选择 **Enable auto-update**。也可以手动运行 `claude plugin marketplace update claude-hud` 和 `claude plugin update claude-hud@claude-hud`，然后运行 `/reload-plugins`。无需重新设置。 ## 显示效果 默认显示两行： ``` [Opus] │ my-project git:(main*) Context █████░░░░░ 45% │ Usage ██░░░░░░░░ 25% (resets in 1h 30m) ``` - **第 1 行**：模型、检测到时的提供商标签（`Bedrock`、`Vertex`、`MiniMax`）、项目路径和 git 分支。 - **第 2 行**：上下文用量（随占用依次变为绿、黄、红）以及订阅用户的使用率限制。 可选行包括工具、子代理和待办，此外还有大约一百个选项： ``` ◐ Edit: auth.ts | ✓ Read ×3 | ✓ Grep ×2 ← 工具 ◐ explore [haiku]: Finding auth code (2m 15s) ← 子代理 ▸ Fix authentication bug (2/5) ← 待办 ``` ## 修改、修复与反馈 直接告诉 Claude，或输入 `/hud` 并说明你想要什么：“显示工具活动”、“使用紧凑布局”、“HUD 是空白的”、“上下文条看起来不对”。Claude 会查找相关选项，给你看预览，并在你同意后保存修改。`/hud` 还可以撤销上一次修改，重放最近一次真实渲染来解释你看到的内容；如果确实是 bug，它会生成一份脱敏报告，你完整读过之后才会提交。 设置保存在 `~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/config.json`（如设置了 `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 则在其下）。要在某个会话中关闭 HUD，用 `CLAUDE_HUD_DISABLE=1` 启动 Claude Code。 ## 安全 HUD 的逻辑运行在一个被锁定的 Node 进程中。Node 的权限模型阻止它启动程序、读取你的凭据，以及写入它自己数据目录以外的任何位置。导入围栏让它拿不到 Node 的网络模块和网络全局对象；这道围栏挡住了目前发现的每一种逃逸方式，每次改动都会逐一测试。一个单独的小文件负责运行它所需的固定 `git`、`jj` 和内存命令。HUD 读取 Claude Code 的 stdin、会话 transcript、Claude 配置文件以及当前目录的 git 或 jj 元数据，不调用未公开的 API。 `--extra-cmd` 会在每次刷新时运行一条 shell 命令，并把输出显示在第一行。除非 HUD 的环境中设置了 `CLAUDE_HUD_ALLOW_EXTRA_CMD=1`，否则它会被忽略。请把它视为任意代码执行，切勿使用来源不可信的命令。 ## 运行环境要求 - Claude Code v2.1.260 或更高版本 - Node.js 22.18 或更高版本（Bun 可以启动 HUD，HUD 随后在 Node 上运行） ## 开发 ```bash git clone https://github.com/jarrodwatts/claude-hud cd claude-hud npm ci && npm test ``` 参见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 许可证 MIT，参见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 ## Star 历史 [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=jarrodwatts/claude-hud&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#jarrodwatts/claude-hud&Date)
